paper_title: Tight Gaps for Vertex Cover in the Sherali-Adams SDP Hierarchy
statement: For large t, proving Conjecture 5.12 seems challenging. We leave it as an open problem. Another open problem is to extend the ideas in this paper to construct tight Lasserre gaps for Vertex Cover and Unique Games, thus giving the strongest evidence that Unique Games cannot be solved with SDP hierarchies.
context: We presented tight integrality gaps for level-6 Sherali-Adams SDP for Vertex Cover and how if a certain analytical conjecture is proved they can be extended to any constant number of rounds. Along the way we also gave an intuitive and geometric proof of tight Sherali- Adams LP integrality gaps for the same problem. While these LP integrality gaps apply to less rounds than [9] they remain highly nontrivial, yet significantly simplified. For large t, proving Conjecture 5.12 seems challenging. We leave it as an open problem. Another open problem is to extend the ideas in this paper to construct tight Lasserre gaps for Vertex Cover and Unique Games, thus giving the strongest evidence that Unique Games cannot be solved with SDP hierarchies.
